user.title: Cloudflare TURN key
user.description:
Lets camera streams relay through Cloudflare when no direct connection is possible: away from home, on mobile data or behind a VPN.

In the [Cloudflare dashboard]({dashboard_url}), go to **Realtime → TURN**, create a TURN key, and copy its **TURN Token ID** and **API token** here. The key stays in Home Assistant: apps and go2rtc only get credentials that expire within 48 hours.

data_description.key_id: The ID of your TURN key.
data_description.api_token: The secret Cloudflare shows once, when the key is created. If you lost it, create a new key.

init.title: Relay transports
init.description: Choose how the apps and go2rtc may reach Cloudflare's relay. Every transport adds a little setup work to each stream, so choose only what you need. The defaults suit most homes: UDP 3478 is the fastest, and TLS 443 gets through almost any firewall or VPN.
